rules.C: C(arm) = median over cells of dM_main - dM_round
rules.S: S(arm) = #cells where the donor-new-source patch is JOINT and the donor-ROUND-source patch of the same arm is not (target host new)
rules.SPEC: SPEC iff dM_main > dM_round in >= 75% of cells AND in a majority of cells for >= 10 of 14 donor groups
rules.SUF: SUF(arm) iff S(arm) >= 1/2 S(full) and SPEC(arm)
rules.ab_verdicts: abc_<s> = the shift at 0-12 + 29-30 with c_30 weight 0 (sh_fAB_c29) at contrast size s. Per responsive host: SMIN_AB = the smallest s in 1/4, 3/8, 1/2, 1 with host S >= 7 (s = 1 from the M13 sh_fAB_c29 rows), SMIN_CS likewise from M13's cs_s025 / cs_s0375 / cs_s05 / cs1 (NONE if no s qualifies, ordered above 1). AB_SMIN_BY_HOST:<host8>=<SMIN_AB>/<SMIN_CS>,...; pooled AB_THRESHOLD_SAME iff equal on every responsive host, AB_THRESHOLD_LOWER iff SMIN_AB <= SMIN_CS everywhere and < somewhere, AB_THRESHOLD_HIGHER iff >= everywhere and > somewhere, else AB_THRESHOLD_MIXED. SHIFT_2930_NEEDED iff not SUF(ab_only_c29) else SHIFT_2930_NOT_NEEDED; AB_T05_SUFFICES iff SUF(abc_t05) else AB_T05_INSUFFICIENT (abc_t05 = the AB shift at half its size per row, c as sh_fAB_c29); per-host S of every Q1 arm is reported
rules.always_reported: S, SPEC, J_main, J_round, median dM and C per arm; S and C per host; leave-one-donor-group-out of every verdict; energy shares, remainder shares, tilt errors, shift size errors; the S and C of each null, pooled and per host; change norm of every arm relative to full
rules.consistency_gate: full = the M3 all-heads patch: its 208 rows equal M3's bitwise and S(full) = 51; meanD_host = the M6 pooled-donor arm: its 208 rows equal M6's bitwise and S = 39 (GPU, checked in the run); sh_fAB_c29 / cs_s0375 / rem_p1 / rnull_s05_1 = the M13 arms (same patch fields) on the 6 subset cells (for each responsive host, its first 2 cells in donor order): their 4 x 12 rows equal M13's bitwise; otherwise every verdict is INCONSISTENT_WITH_M3_M6_M13 and no claim
rules.interpretation_fixed_in_advance: AB_THRESHOLD_SAME: confining the shift to the author and block lines costs no contrast size on any responsive host; SHIFT_2930_NOT_NEEDED: the shift is needed only at 0-12, and c alone carries the round value; AB_T05_SUFFICES: half the AB shift is enough. REM_OPPOSES with REM3_DIRECTION_SPECIFIC (S or C): the in-subspace remainder r works against the round-specific repair beyond a random orthogonal push of the same size at sizes where a host can move; since cpar16_sm is approximately c scaled to about 0.58 plus about 1.77 r per row (along-c share of P c about 1/3 of its energy, r about 2/3), this would account for M12's SUBSPACE_BELOW_COSINE on 264c458d; with REM3_DIRECTION_NOT_SPECIFIC any orthogonal push of that size does the same. All arms except full are pooled-donor arms (effectively 8 host replicates, 3 responding in M9-M13); per-host S is the honest unit; C is a continuous margin and moves without any host crossing threshold
rules.readouts: M = conflict margin; A = logit(reject_conflict) - max(accept, wait); JOINT = M > 0 and A > 0; dM = M(patch) - M(in-run capture of host new)
rules.responsive_host: a host where S(cs1) on its cells exceeds half its cells, with cs1 read from the pinned M13 raw rows
rules.size_gate: every tilt arm and null keeps c's component along c and has tilt norm |lam| ||r|| (nulls: 3 ||r||) within 1e-6 relative to ||c|| (fail-closed, as M13); abc_t05 has its shift at half size per row within 1e-3 (fail-closed); the abc arms set c_30 to 0 exactly
rules.tilt_null_verdicts: rnull3_<s>_<i> = c + 3 q with q orthogonal to c, ||q|| = ||r|| per row and position, its direction drawn at random (seed per cell and i, the same at both s and for main and round), so the push has the norm of 3 r. Per responsive host h and s, N = the 8 nulls. S test: (h, s) is informative unless the host S of rem_p3, rem_m3 and the 8 nulls are all 0 or all equal to h's cell count; on informative pairs add = S_h(rem_p3): HARM_BEYOND_NULL iff add < min N, LESS_HARM_THAN_NULL iff add > max N, else AT; remove = S_h(rem_m3): REMOVAL_BEYOND_NULL iff remove > max N, REMOVAL_BELOW_NULL iff remove < min N, else AT. Pooled REM3_S: REM3_DIRECTION_SPECIFIC iff some BEYOND and no LESS_HARM / REMOVAL_BELOW; REM3_DIRECTION_NOT_SPECIFIC iff all AT; REM3_DIRECTION_REVERSED iff some LESS_HARM / REMOVAL_BELOW and no BEYOND; else REM3_DIRECTION_MIXED; REM3_DIRECTION_UNINFORMATIVE iff no pair is informative. C test on every responsive (h, s): C_h = median over h's cells of dM_main - dM_round; the same rules with C_h in place of S_h give REM3_C (REM3C_DIRECTION_*). REM3_BY_HOST lists both per (h, s)
rules.tilt_verdicts: r = P c - (P c . c^) c^ per question row and span position (P = projector on the first 16 right singular vectors of the cell's same-arm pairs basis, as M13); rem_<lam>_<s> = c + lam r at size s, main -s/2, round +s/2, with s = 7/16 and 5/16. Per s, with S at lam -3, -1, 0 (cs_<s>), +1, +3: TILT_OPPOSES iff S is non-increasing in lam and S(-3) > S(+3); TILT_SUPPORTS iff non-decreasing and S(-3) < S(+3); TILT_NO_EFFECT iff all equal; else TILT_MIXED. Pooled: REM_OPPOSES iff some s is TILT_OPPOSES and every s is TILT_OPPOSES or TILT_NO_EFFECT; REM_SUPPORTS likewise; REM_NO_EFFECT iff both TILT_NO_EFFECT; else REM_MIXED. The same rule per responsive host is reported as TILT_BY_HOST
rules.units: the 104 cross-group cells of M1-M6; cells share donors and hosts, and the pooled-mean arms vary with the donor only through the pool exclusion (effectively 8 hosts), so counts are descriptive decision rules, not independent tests; per-host S is always reported
